protocol.claimBoundary: Physical representation, spacing and runtime consistency in bounded fixtures. Finite count capacity is an admission constraint, not an empirical saturated-flow estimate. No general spillback, intersection, SUMO equivalence, field accuracy or city-scale performance claim.

claim: Bounded opt-in single-lane Car spillback engineering acceptance. No empirical or general network validity claim.

queue.definition: Vehicles on the approach with speed below 0.1 m/s, sampled at equal times; this is the halted queue, not every vehicle slowed by congestion.

dischargeHeadways.definition: Consecutive first-road exit event times within the same green interval; report count and match by vehicle pair.
